The text jumps directly from the 'Mary Wilks...' quote to the next section 'Council and Committees at Work' without including the image.

concerns.analysis: The table in Appendix C spans pages 36, 37, and 38. In the source PDF, the column headers ('TITLE', 'CUSTODIAN') appear only on page 36, and the data rows continue consecutively across pages 37 and 38. The extraction output incorrectly splits this continuous table into two separate table objects: one on page 36 (which correctly merges data from pages 36 and 37) and a new, isolated table on page 38. Because it is rendered as a standalone table, the data on page 38 completely lacks column headers,
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Table rows continuing on page 38 starting with: 'Shellfish Growing Areas | DENR, NC Shellfish Sanitation and Recreational...'
concerns.output_quote: A separate table object is created on page 38 starting with 'Shellfish Growing Areas' at row_start: 0, completely omitting the required 'TITLE' and 'CUSTODIAN' column headers.
